name: Badge
layerWhy: It states one short fact about something; no job.
promise: This thing has this fact: New, 3, Overdue.
expectation: A small pill on or beside the thing.
evidence: Always words or a number, so it reads without colour; the tone only adds.
behaviour: A number is lined up as tabular digits.
relationships: It belongs to the thing it sits on.
accessibility: An aria-label when a number needs words ("12 unread").
dont: A badge and a status saying the same thing.
